failure.detail: The first retry reached approximately 1.389 GiB working set while streaming the first real layer; the run was stopped before candidate training and before any score was written.
failure.cuda_retry: An earlier attempt also hit CUDA error cudaErrorDevicesUnavailable during first-layer construction; a standalone CUDA allocation subsequently succeeded.

interpretation: This is a resource-gate failure, not an architecture result. No candidate wins and no reconstruction gate may be inferred.
